## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `153be45da1e1a6064c21597c5faadf580f5945b7`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/dogfood-verification/SKILL.md + package.json (root scripts), turbo.json, packages/console/package.json, packages/console/build-dist.sh, ui/apps/console/package.json, packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs, scripts/check-dev-prereqs.mjs

Inputs: card #26035 body and all 9 comments (ruling 6435329940 letter A, claim 6435602582, os-dev-report 6435948225); PR #26536 body, file list and `git diff d2ca7079..153be45d` (2 files, +3/-3, no changeset); the 42 check-runs on the head. No PR comments, reviews or review threads exist on the head.

Check-runs on 153be45d at read time: every completed run is `success` or `skipped` (skips are path-filtered: UI shards, Build Core, docs, dogfood shards, opt-in harnesses); no run concluded `failure`. Succeeded: Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, the three claim guards (same issue / same single-writer path / card claims this branch), Part-of guard, Test Core, Dogfood Regression Gate, Lint · ESLint, Lint · repo & tooling gates (the job that runs `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`, lint.yml L513/L944), Lint · CI release & engine gates, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, the three scoped Lint jobs, Type Check · workspace. Still `in_progress` at read time: Type Check · source gates, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Lint · docs & code guards — none of them reads `.claude/**` for a judgment this diff could move, but their conclusions are not yet on the head.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set: none widened, none narrowed. The diff rewrites two prose instructions inside `.claude/skills/**`; no gate, hook, test, schema, script or workflow changes. The acceptance grep the ruling names (`git grep -nE "objectui:(build|refresh|bump|clean)" -- .claude/skills`) returns exactly the two lines on `origin/main` d2ca7079 (checklist-test L69, dogfood-verification L90) and nothing on the head (exit 1) — right, and it is the ruling's own measure.
- Public surface: none. `.claude/**` is internal agent protocol, never published (check-skill-frame-sync header; package.json `files` of no package includes it). No `exports`, no `packages/spec`, no generated artifact touched — right.
- Governed-path face: `.claude/**` is a governed rules path, so the review is owed at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` and the PR lands by a GOVERNED_APPROVERS approval; the PR is draft, auto-merge not armed, `Ruling-ref: 6435329940` on the body — right, and matches claim 6435602582.
- Line ratchet (`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`): counts unchanged, 238/238 (checklist-test, headroom 0) and 148/157 (dogfood-verification); every edited line is within `MAX_LINE_BYTES = 120` (checklist-test L69 is 119 bytes + newline, dogfood L90 97, L91 80). The gate ran green in Lint · repo & tooling gates — right. One render-level caveat is in ④.

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: no` on the PR body, consistent with the claim and the ruling. No changeset in the diff and the `skip-changeset` label is on the PR; Check Changeset concluded `success`. The diff publishes nothing (`.claude/**` ships in no package), so `skip-changeset` matches what the diff publishes — right. No `(narrowing)` arm, no `!` in the title, no dogfood battery owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- PR author login: `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay); the commit author on 153be45d is `os-steve`, the account the claim names. Branch `claude/project-thread-pr6axl` matches the claim's identity record; the card-claims-branch guard concluded `success`.
- `open_questions`: `[]` in os-dev-report 6435948225 — nothing to answer.
- `out_of_scope_findings` (one, carrier none): dogfood-verification L76–L93 still frames the retired pin route as live (`/_console` "pinned by `.objectui-sha`", `build-console.sh` stamping `packages/console/dist/.objectui-sha`, and `pnpm check:console-sha`). Verified on `origin/main`: there is no `.objectui-sha`, no `scripts/build-console.sh`, and no root `check:console-sha` script in `package.json` (`packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts` L542 records it as retired; `scripts/check-dev-prereqs.mjs` comments still mention it but the root `dev` script no longer runs it). The drift refusal and `OS_ALLOW_CONSOLE_DRIFT=1` do still exist in `console.ts` L407–L531, kept by slice 3 for the objectos overlay, so the two sentences about them are not false. Escalated, not blocking: ruling 6435329940 letter A spends this review on the two `objectui:*` lines only, and the dev disclosed the remainder. The seat decides whether a sibling slice of #26035 carries L76–L93; recommended, since L91 (an edited line) still ends by prescribing `pnpm check:console-sha`, which cannot run.
- Dev flags in the PR body: "`vendored console dist`" on checklist-test L68 kept — verified: `packages/console/build-dist.sh` copies `ui/apps/console/dist` into `packages/console/dist`, so the phrase holds. The cold-build budget "~10–30 分钟" on L71 is consistent with the dev's measured 14m7s under lock.
- Nothing in the dev's gates line is contradicted by CI: the 16 derived families the dev ran all exit 0 and the corresponding CI jobs concluded `success`.

### ④ Design judgment

Per hits file, read against the cited code on `origin/main` d2ca7079 and the ruling's acceptance ("grep → 0; the two skills' examples still run"):

**.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md L69** — "在仓库根目录跑 `pnpm console:build`,源码在 `ui/`,改 Console 就改那里". True on main: root `package.json` L27 `console:build` = `turbo run build:dist --filter=@objectstack/console`; `turbo.json` L80–83 makes `@objectstack/console#build:dist` depend on `@object-ui/console#build`, whose package lives at `ui/apps/console` (`@object-ui/console` 18.2.0, `build` = tsc + vite build + sdui manifest + plugin); `packages/console/build-dist.sh` copies that dist into `packages/console/dist` with the tracked `sdui.manifest.json`. The surrounding paragraph still holds: "它与 showcase 工作区闭包**分开**构建" is true because `turbo.json` declares no `@objectstack/console#build` task and `packages/console` has only `build:dist`, so the root `pnpm build` (task `build`) does not produce the console dist; the following clause (first boot 404 on `/_console/` until it exists) matches the CLI's not-built path. The sentence reads coherently inside its bullet; the replaced "从钉住的 `.objectui-sha` 构建" was the only false claim on the line. The dev's own run (`@objectstack/console dist ready … from ui/apps/console`) is the acceptance's "example still runs". Holds.

**.claude/skills/dogfood-verification/SKILL.md L90–91** — remedy sentence "跑 **`pnpm console:build`**(在仓库根目录跑,从本仓 `ui/` 下的 Console 源码重建;改 Console 就改 `ui/` 下的源码)再重启". True on main and identical to the CLI's own remedy: `console.ts` `describeConsoleShaDrift` prints "Rebuild the console: pnpm console:build" (L516), `formatConsoleShaDriftWarning` names the same script (L490), and `detectConsoleShaDrift` L478 treats an unstamped dist (what every `pnpm console:build` since #25745 produces) as no drift — so the prescribed remedy does clear the refusal it is attached to. The dropped `objectui:refresh` clause described a script and a `../objectui` pin bump that no longer exist. Within the sentence the edit is coherent. Two residuals, neither on the ruling's two lines:
1. The bullet's framing (L86–89: `build-console.sh` stamps `.objectui-sha`; the repo's pin) and the next sentence on L91 (`pnpm check:console-sha` reports the same comparison without booting) describe a route main no longer has; `check:console-sha` is not a root script. The edited sentence is true inside a stale frame. Should-fix via a sibling slice (③), not a defect of this diff.
2. Render: L90 now ends on a Han character followed by ASCII `;` (`…源码重建;` then newline). That is exactly the #12081 junction the ratchet header documents — invisible in source, rendered as a space ("重建; 改 Console") for the agent reading the rendered skill. The gate does not red it (lines of 120 bytes or fewer are never re-wrapped, `wrapLine` only refuses to offer that break), so CI is green, but the corpus rule is to not end a line there. Should-fix, one-token move: carry "改 Console" onto L90 (97 → 109 bytes) so L91 starts "就改 `ui/` 下的源码)再重启。", or break after the `)`. Not blocking.

Both files: no rule was added, removed or narrowed; the two instructions now point at a script that exists and at the source tree that the build reads. The card's acceptance holds on the head; no gate is skipped.

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · devx seat 2 · 2026-10-27T07:16Z

Seat `domain:devx#2` (#20163) · `session_01Q4MDXRbEJCNdPAP4SiXwp9` · reviewed head `153be45d` · card #26035 slice 1 (claim 6435602582, branch `claude/project-thread-pr6axl`), ruling 6435329940 letter A. Thread-read: none.

- **Diff:** two files under `.claude/skills/**`, +3/−3, line counts unchanged. `objectui:build` / `objectui:refresh` are replaced by `pnpm console:build`, which is the root script on `main` (`turbo run build:dist --filter=@objectstack/console`, built from `ui/apps/console`) and the remedy `packages/cli` itself prints for console drift.
- **Acceptance:** `git grep -nE "objectui:(build|refresh|bump|clean)" -- .claude/skills` hits the two lines on `d2ca7079` and nothing on this head. The thread ran `pnpm console:build` (exit 0).
- **Contract review:** the `## Contract review` record above, at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` on `153be45da1`, is a PASS, rendered by an isolated reviewer and adopted by this seat. `check-governed-merges` reads this PR as governed (Tier S).
- **CI:** 44 check-runs on the head, 25 success and 19 path-skipped, none red.
- **Left for a later slice, not this PR:** the same bullet in `dogfood-verification/SKILL.md` (L76–93) still describes the retired pin route (`.objectui-sha`, `build-console.sh`, and `pnpm check:console-sha`, which is no longer a root script). The record's should-fix about L90 ending on Han + ASCII `;` lands in that rewrite too. Noted on #26035.

Landing: the PR stays a draft with auto-merge off. This seat does not ready or arm a governed PR; it waits for a maintainer (GOVERNED_APPROVERS) to approve and land it. The card stays open for its later slices.
